args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.2.9 due to failed health checks

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

**Rollback**
- `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (18% error rate).
- First rollback attempt to v2.3.0 was rejected — that version is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**.
- Rolled back instead to **v2.2.9**, the most recent healthy release not under quarantine. Rollout succeeded and is verified healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west (error rate now 0.2%).

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, paged on-call, with full details of the failure and the rollback path (including the v2.3.0 quarantine and the decision to go to v2.2.9).

**Follow-ups worth noting:**
- v2.3.1 needs root-causing before any redeploy.
- v2.3.0 should be un-quarantined only after CVE-2026-4417 is remediated.
